 The cost of silos
 
 
Marketing buys the lead. Support gets the reply. 
The customer pays the difference.
 
Most platforms send messages. Almost none manage the conversation that follows. The gap between the two is where revenue quietly leaks out.
 
 
 
 
39%
 
name data silos as the number one barrier to CX maturity. Not budget. Not talent.
 
 
 
12%
 
of companies have a single, unified view of their customer across every channel.
 
 
 
50%+
 
of customers switch to a competitor after a single bad experience.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The Solution
 
Every channel. One platform. 
One profile.
 
Reach customers where they are, with full context carried across every touchpoint. No channel is secondary.
 
 
 
 
 
 
WhatsApp
 
Two-way conversations at scale, with Flows, commerce, and human handoff.

Real-time web and mobile push with behavioral triggers and AI send times.

OTPs and sensitive alerts inside your trusted app. Phishing-resistant, lower cost.

Behavioral triggers and dynamic content driven by the unified profile.

How it works
 
One loop. 
The advantage compounds.
 
Data acts. AI learns from the result. The result feeds the next action. The longer it runs, the sharper it gets.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
One Unified
Profile
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
01
 
Unify
 
Every interaction lands in one profile, stitched across web, app, WhatsApp, SMS and more.

Agents

04
 
Learn
 
Every result feeds back. The next decision starts smarter than the last.

Sharper every pass.

, so 
the advantage compounds with every interaction.

Incapto built Coffee as a Service on a WhatsApp Panic Button. A Gen AI agent, trained with RAG on Incapto's own catalog, resolves support without inventing an answer and hands off to a human when it needs to. Marketing, ordering, and support run in one thread.

Incapto
 
Coffee subscription · WhatsApp Gen AI

of bot chats resolved with no human

average order value

churn rate

MRR from the Panic Button alone

Seamless Customer Journeys
 
 
01
 
Design and execute end-to-end customer journeys tailored to every individual’s preferences and behaviors.
 
 
Build personalized journeys across multiple channels
 
Use segmentation and automation to deliver the right message at the right time
 
Optimize engagement with real-time data and predictive analytics
 
 
 
 
 
 
Omnichannel Communication Campaign Automation
 
 
02
 
AI-powered tools to simplify and enhance your marketing, operational, and support workflows.
 
 
Automate tasks like A/B testing, campaign scheduling, and user segmentation
 
Test creative variations to find the most effective message for your audience
 
Focus on strategy while the platform handles execution and optimization
 
 
 
 
 
 
Integrate Effortlessly with Your Ecosystem
 
 
03
 
Connect indigitall with your existing tools and platforms for streamlined operations.
 
 
Integrate with CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot to unify customer data
 
Access real-time insights and reporting for a holistic view
 
Sync data across platforms to ensure accuracy and consistency
 
 
 
 
 
 
Engage Customers with Interactive Content
 
 
04
 
Deliver dynamic, visually engaging experiences to captivate your audience.
 
 
Use multimedia-rich notifications to make an impact
 
Customize messages for every channel, ensuring consistent branding and tone
 
Stand out with push notifications, surveys, and promotional offers
